title: Fourth Time
paragraphs: We knocked on the door of the weapon shop, which had already closed. A faint light was leaking out, suggesting they hadn’t gone to bed yet.
“What’s this? I was just about to hit the sack… Oh, it’s you guys from earlier today. And you, the guy with the spear, this is your first time here. And the rest…”
The queen peeked out from her robe.
“Y-Your Majesty!? I mean, Your Highness!?”
The weapon shop owner bowed deeply.
“W-Why are you here!?”
“I’m conducting a little investigation in secret. Please raise your head and treat us as you normally would.”
Ren and Itsuki nodded, seemingly convinced by the weapon shop owner’s reaction.
“Sorry for bothering you so late.”
“S-So, what brings you here at this hour? If it’s weapons you want, can’t it wait until tomorrow…?”
Oh? He’s suddenly speaking very politely.

Is it because of the queen? We mentioned the story about the chainmail that Father bought earlier in the day. However, while the crimson swine’s face was vaguely remembered, the queen had a clear recollection.
“I wouldn’t feel good knowing that something from my shop was used for a crime. But if you’re returning it, I’ll throw in a little extra next time you stop by.”
By the time we returned in the previous loop, the shop was already closed.

Should I mention that? No, the future will likely be different this time, so it should be fine. After that, I also requested the meteorite iron series from the weapon shop owner. Perhaps because the queen was with us, he brought them from the warehouse immediately.
“To think you even have such rare items… Perhaps you should be appointed the royal court’s exclusive blacksmith.”
“Th-That’s more than I deserve… But if possible, I’d still like to sell weapons to regular adventurers.”
His speech was a mix of formal and casual.
“Alright, we’ll be borrowing these then.”
“Yeah.”
Ah… I should also remember not to mention anything about copying weapons.
“Well, we’ve confirmed everything, so we’ll take our leave now.”
“Yeah, I’ll be looking forward to seeing you again.”
And with that, we left the weapon shop. By now, Ren and Itsuki should be fully convinced.
“Indeed… There’s no way to know about those hidden weapons in that shop without coming from the future.”
“Why was it hidden in the first place?”
“If I told you at the start, not only I but also Naofumi would have been nearly killed and forced to leave the country.”
“I see. So, you’re following the best possible route?”
“Then why did you loop again this time?”
Oh, they asked.
“Did you make a mistake or lose during a wave?”
“Possibly.”
Oh? Ren and Itsuki seem to have come to their own conclusion.
“I don’t really know. But it seems like even I have a limited time in this world.”
“Is that so?”
“If I exceed a certain amount of time, I end up looping again.”
“Then isn’t everything meaningless? Doesn’t that mean it all gets erased?”
Ren said, looking slightly disheartened.
“I won’t give up.”
“Ren, that’s a bit rash. Maybe only Motoyasu ends up being transferred somewhere. Let’s not give up.”
“Hmm… You’re right. I wouldn’t want to believe that all your efforts have been meaningless.”
That’s good. In the previous loop, Father and the others got along very well. Even if I’m not around, I hope they’ll continue to be close.
“We’ve gathered enough evidence. But to catch Altcray red-handed…”
“Are we going to wake up Naofumi now and talk to him?”
“No, if we wake him now, won’t he think we’re the culprits?”
“Exactly. Based on my knowledge from the loops, it’s best to intervene when he’s being falsely accused.”
“…You’re right. If we protect Naofumi when he realizes he’s been deceived, he’s more likely to trust us.”
“Last time, we pretended to be deceived and caught them in the act. We also heard about it from the queen last time.”
With that, we planned for the events of the next morning. Trash, and the crimson swine. You’re already surrounded.
“By the way, because of the loop, there may be things I’ll tell Ren, Itsuki… and Naofumi later that might be hard to believe.”
“Got it.”
“Yeah, given the situation, it’s probably best to believe it.”
“Last time, Ren and Itsuki had a lot to say about not believing certain things. Especially about what I… really want to call Naofumi and why.”
“Is… is there something?”
Itsuki asked nervously.
“Well… you’ll understand that after you clear Naofumi’s false charges tomorrow.”
I’m tempted to talk about it now, but it’s better to wait until Father is present. Ren and Itsuki agreed with that plan last time as well.
“For now, we should focus on eliminating the country’s conspiracy, right?”
“Exactly. If we silently try to leave the country, the Three Hero Church will relentlessly pursue us.”
“That’s a troublesome scenario. The question is… can we believe all this?”
Itsuki had a sour look on his face.
“Either way, everything will be revealed tomorrow. If Motoyasu tells us then, it might be worth listening to.”
“…Indeed.”
“Well then, Heroes, I’ll see you tomorrow.”
The queen gave a bow. After that, the queen returned to her fiancé and mentioned that she would be on standby in the attic all night. It seems she wants to make sure to secure the evidence.
“See you tomorrow.”
“Yeah.”

We dispersed, just like in the previous loop. Everything else proceeded almost exactly the same. In the morning, the crimson swine will come waddling to me with a false accusation, and I will pretend to be deceived and head to the castle to speak with Trash. Ren and Itsuki’s reactions will be almost identical to last time. The queen is also expected to make an appearance later. Now, I’m in the throne room, waiting for Father to be brought in. Ren, Itsuki, and I exchange glances and nod. I’m getting fed up with the lies from the crimson swine and Trash. When you know the truth, this whole charade just feels ridiculous. Eventually, Father is brought in wearing only his undergarments, and Ren and Itsuki seem convinced. They realize that this is a conspiracy and that Trash and the crimson swine are the true villains. Of course, with everything going so smoothly, it’s only natural that doubts might arise about whether I’m pulling the strings behind the scenes. Ren and Itsuki from the previous loop had pointed that out. I won’t forget to take care of that aspect properly this time.
“Myne!”
Ah, how pitiful. Every time I see this, my heart aches. Last time, I managed to return the chainmail to Father. I’ll do the same this time.

Father… I remember how, unlike in the first world, he was kind to everyone and even cooked for me, Ren, and Itsuki to show his gratitude. I may never see that version of him again, but I will save this Father. Father is someone who returns kindness with kindness and harshness with severity. However, that severity is merely a reflection of how he treats others. With strangers, he may be cautious, but if they do no wrong, he responds with goodwill. That’s why Father is praised in the prophecy of the Four Saint Church.
“W-What’s with that attitude?”
Father looked around at everyone, speechless. He probably feels like he’s being interrogated. Ren, Itsuki, and I look at him with sympathy. Father, who is unknowingly being framed.
This time… I will even get back the clothes that the crimson swine stole from him!
“Do you truly have no memory of this?”

Of course, he doesn’t. This is all an act to let Trash and the crimson swine show their true colors. I’ve already explained to Ren and Itsuki that we can go along with the flow and get closer, just like last time. Things are unfolding exactly as I said, and Ren and Itsuki look a little unnerved. But this is exactly what happened in the previous loop.
“I don’t know what you’re talking about… wait, ah!”

Father’s timing for realizing things hasn’t changed at all. That chainmail belongs to Father, but I also want to return the clothes the crimson swine stole from him. I forgot last time, but this time, I’ll make sure Father doesn’t lose anything.
“So, you’re the pillow thief!”
“Who’s a pillow thief!? I never imagined they’d be such vile scum!”
“‘They’? Vile scum? What are you talking about?”
Oops, I slipped up again. That was something Father warned me about in the previous loop. I need to reflect on that. But at this point, it’s checkmate.
“Well then, what are the charges against the Shield Hero?”
“Charges? What are you talking about?”
“Buhi… Buhibuhibuhi!”
“Huh?”
“Bububububububuhibuhibuhi—!”
The crimson swine wailed and approached me. Ugh, I feel sick. That filthy, vile creature shouldn’t even be breathing near me.
“Buhihihihi, buhihi!”
“Eh?”
Father’s face turned to one of pure disbelief.
“What are you talking about? After dinner last night, I just went to my room and slept.”
Exactly. And on top of that, his fiancé was keeping watch in the attic all night. Father’s innocence is now indisputable. There’s no way his fiancé would lie. Now, I need to play my part.
“Lying like that… then why is she crying so much?”
“Why are you defending Myne? And where did you get that chainmail?”
This belongs to Father. I took it back from the crimson swine. I’ll return it immediately. Just thinking that made my expression loosen a bit.

Father tilted his head slightly, reading my expression. Father, you’ve always put up with my selfishness. When I wished to see Filo-tan again, you even asked Ren and Itsuki to help search for her. I haven’t forgotten how much I owe you for raising more Filolials than ever before. Even though we never found Filo-tan, Father, I haven’t forgotten how hard you worked to investigate. In this loop, I will gather even more Filolials to aid in finding Filo-tan. Father, I’m counting on you. And for that… this is a necessary trial.
I will clear away all your grief, Father!
“Ah, yesterday, I went to a tavern alone to drink, and while we were drinking together for a while, they gave me this chainmail as a gift.”
“Huh?”
Just a little more time until the agreed moment.
“That’s right! King! I was robbed in my sleep—my entire fortune and all my equipment except my shield were stolen! Please, catch the culprit!”
“Silence, you scum!”
Trash roared.
Heh… it’s almost over for you. Thinking he trapped Father, you’re the one about to be ensnared by your own wife. You’ll fall into the trap set by the wife who comes from the future.
“Forcing your vile desires on unwilling citizens is an unforgivable atrocity. If you weren’t a Hero, you’d be executed immediately!”
“I’m telling you, it’s a misunderstanding! I didn’t do it!”
In the previous loop, I was only focused on Father at this moment, but this time I’ll glance at Ren and Itsuki.

Oh… Ren and Itsuki are surprisingly good actors. They’re giving nasty, sinister grins. They know exactly what’s going on and are acting it out. Their expressions are nothing like what Ren and Itsuki would normally show. The soldiers press Father’s head down to the ground as the three of us stand in a circle around him.
“You! So you pinned a false crime on him just to steal his preparation money and equipment!”
Ah, that voice… it reminds me of the Father from the first world. The great Father from that world… are you watching? I’ll save Father as many times as it takes.
“Don’t mess with me! You were after my money from the start, weren’t you? You planned this with your comrades to distribute the equipment!”
I glance at Father with a gentle expression.
“How many faces do you have!?”
Oh dear, Father misunderstood.
“Bububuu.”
The crimson swine jeered. How annoying. I glare at her with murderous intent.
Father tilted his head again.
“Coming to another world and having comrades pull something like this… it’s disgusting.”
“Indeed. I have no sympathy either. I had my doubts, but now I’m sure.”
“Exactly. Father—I’ll save you now!”
I removed the chainmail with one hand and swept away the soldiers restraining Father with my spear. They had such sinister smiles… it makes me want to kill them.
Should I kill them? The voices of the Father and others from the previous loop echo in my head, telling me to stop.
“Uwaaaahhh!”
As Father regained his freedom, I offered him my hand to help him up.
“It’s okay now. Here, I’m returning this.”
Then I handed the chainmail to Father.
“Eh…? Eh?”
“Motoyasu-dono!?”

Trash wore a shocked expression, realizing things had not gone as he had imagined. You’ll understand soon enough. After all, you’ll be used by the crimson swine and witness the downfall of the kingdom even after your death. Well, I’ve been told not to kill them this time. I’ll enjoy watching how this plays out.
“This is a conspiracy. Fa—Naofumi didn’t do it. I believe him.”
“Yes, Naofumi-san is innocent. You can’t fool us.”
“You’re trying to divide us and manipulate us for your own gain, but we won’t let that happen.”
Ren and Itsuki pointed their weapons at Trash, the crimson swine, and the kingdom’s soldiers.
“You’ve been running wild while the queen was away, but what do you think she’ll say when she sees the state of this kingdom?”
“D-Damn you!”

Ah, any moment now… that demon will arrive with killing intent. Victory is already in my grasp. All that’s left is to buy time until the queen arrives. Ren and Itsuki don’t trust you, and the queen is coming. You’re already caught in the trap. You thought you were setting the trap, but you’re the one caught—how laughable.
“This is the fourth time I’ve protected Father here. This is my conviction. No matter how many times I’m warned, I will never change.”
Yes, my determination, my wish, and my loyalty to Filo-tan…
All of it is poured into this.
“I’ve come from the future to repay my debt to you, Father.”
For some reason, the air froze a little.
“Why are you calling Naofumi-san ‘Father’?”
“Yeah. You’ll explain later, right?”
“I’ll explain later.”
“Eh? Eh? Eh?”
Father stared at us in shock.
“It’s no surprise. I didn’t believe Motoyasu-san either until he showed me the evidence.”
“Yeah, I was almost made a fool too.”
“By the way… they’ll be here soon, right? Timing-wise, where are they hiding?”
“I don’t know. But it’ll be any moment now.”
Ren and Itsuki have already distanced themselves from their comrades. After all, they know betrayal is coming.
Chapter 760 – Scream
“W-What on earth…?”
“I’ll explain in detail later. But to be brief, I’ve experienced all of this before, Father.”
“Father?”
Ah, I can finally call him that comfortably.
“Didn’t Motoyasu-san just say that? He said he’d explain later.”
“Ah, that’s right… If I had to put it another way, Motoyasu knows everything about the game. Naofumi, he wants to help you.”
“Haah… Alright, for now. I understand.”
Father seems to be postponing the matter for now. Then, with tears in his eyes, Father nodded.
“I see… I thought it was strange how Motoyasu-kun’s eyes seemed more sympathetic than accusatory toward me. So, it was all an act.”
“It was necessary to draw out the enemy.”
“Naofumi didn’t do it. He was just sleeping.”
“Naofumi-san is innocent. We guarantee it. We also believe that this chainmail was stolen.”
“Yeah… yeah. Thank you.”

I’ve seen it before, but Father’s face is a mess, overflowing with tears. His feelings of relief at being believed are palpable. These events will serve as a lesson, making Father even kinder. Even Ren and Itsuki seem a little embarrassed.
“Bubububu! Bubuhibububu!?”

The crimson swine started making a ruckus. What an incredibly ugly crying face. Compared to Father, it’s like heaven and earth. How utterly fake. The difference between someone pleading their innocence and a liar is this vast. Even if the false tears are convincing, they’re meaningless before those of us who know the truth. Ren and Itsuki seem to have fully grasped the difference.
“Such shallow tears. Naofumi-san’s words resonate much deeper.”
“That’s right. Don’t think your lies will fool us.”
“If Motoyasu-san hadn’t warned us, I shudder to think that we might have believed you.”
“They say beautiful flowers are often poisonous… but this is a deadly toxin. And to think you enjoy watching others suffer makes it even worse.”
“After hearing that, I also paid close attention. I saw you secretly provoking Naofumi-san.”
Oh? Did Itsuki notice? How did he manage that? As I wondered, he pointed to the soldiers restraining Father.
“It was a reflex. I spotted it while carefully observing.”
“Impressive.”

Itsuki has precision abilities, so his eyesight must be excellent. If he was looking carefully, it’s no surprise he saw it. Eventually, Ren and Itsuki took up their weapons. Since I wasn’t stalking them this time, their levels should be a bit higher. Well, no matter how many enemies appear, neither Ren nor Itsuki will get hurt with me around.

“Amaki-dono, Kawasumi-dono, Kitamura-dono, what is the meaning of this? Do you intend to defend the Shield Hero, who attempted to violate his companion? Even if you are fellow otherworlders, this is not something that should be forgiven.”
“You’re the acting king, right? You still have time. If you apologize sincerely, I might let this slide.”
“That’s right. Continuing this farce is just adding to your shame. Give it up.”
Trash stood up, trying to hide his frustration as he attempted to explain himself.
“Amaki-dono, Kawasumi-dono, Kitamura-dono! Don’t be swayed by fleeting emotions! You can’t save the world by trusting such an ingrate!”
“Ingrate? How laughable. You summoned us, and the moment an inconvenient Hero was called, you pinned a false crime on him to punish him.”
“Hmph, you think I don’t know? I know the truth. This country views the Shield Hero as an enemy of their religion.”
“An enemy of their religion!?”
Father looked at me in surprise. I nodded.
“The Shield Hero is an inconvenient existence for this Melromarc.”
Father nodded repeatedly in stunned understanding.
“I see… So that’s why those unnatural stares… And this conspiracy…”
“If they had killed Father secretly right after the summoning, we would have been suspicious. With the status of a Hero, such an act would draw condemnation from other nations.”
“There’s no saving them. Just give it up. Such schemes won’t work in front of the Heroes!”
“If they had just kept him under tight protection, he wouldn’t have been able to escape. I’m speechless.”
Ren coldly cut Trash down with his words.
“Anyway, enough of this farce. We’re not going to be your puppets.”
“That’s right. We’ve seen your evil with our own eyes. It’s time to change your ways!”
Itsuki firmly pointed at Trash, declaring it. His words were slightly different from the previous time. That’s because they know the queen will arrive to deliver judgment.
“Buhi!”
The crimson swine stopped her fake crying and spat out something. Just like last time, she revealed her true colors. I’ve been given permission to kill her this time.
When should I do it?
“Grrr…”
Trash groaned in frustration.
Now, will you give up? Of course not. I can’t wait to see the expression on your face in just a moment.
“You should’ve just done as we wished… Enough of this!”
As expected, Trash stood up and declared loudly.
“Men! Kill these fake heroes immediately!”
“Buhii! Buhibuhii!”

Crimson swine, your death is inevitable. I’ve used you to gain Father’s trust. That’s more than enough. But if I kill her here, the queen might scold me. Then again, considering it’s her daughter’s mess, she might forgive me. Ah, that reminds me, there was something I’ve always wanted to try. If I kill the crimson swine here, Trash will probably get loud and ignore the queen’s restraint. It’s probably best to avoid that.
“No matter. We’ll just perform the next Hero summoning ritual. This time, we’ll summon the real heroes!”
“If that’s the order, then it can’t be helped.”
Ren and Itsuki’s comrades drew their weapons and pointed them at us. Ren and Itsuki exchanged looks, half-exasperated. More soldiers gathered, surrounding us.
“…Everything is going exactly as Motoyasu-san predicted.”
“Yeah. It’s almost like it was scripted.”
This is nothing but a farce. Queen, it’s about time. That’s what I thought, but… she’s still not here.
“Motoyasu-san.”
Itsuki looked at me with concern.
“Isn’t she supposed to be coming?”
“There’s no way we’re missing just that part, right?”
“W-What’s going on?”
Something’s not right. The queen should be arriving soon. As I focused on the surroundings, I sensed magical energy outside the room. I also thought I could hear the distant sound of fighting.
Could it be that something is delaying the queen’s arrival?
“Buhihihihii! Bububu!”
“Yes! Low-level fake heroes are no better than babies!”
Trash declared that, and then a shadow appeared beside him. It whispered in his ear.
“Hmph. Mirellia is engaged in diplomacy far away. It’s just a body double trying to abuse her authority. Capture them quickly!”

Oh, the commotion outside must be the queen. It seems they were trying to catch her in the act but were stopped. The interference is undoubtedly from the Three Heroes Church. This situation is beyond what both Father and the queen anticipated.
“Looks like Motoyasu-san was right.”
“Yeah, I’m certain after hearing that name.”
“W-What do you mean? Is everything okay?”
“It’s fine. If I wanted to, I could kill everyone here in an instant.”
“Hey, that’s a bit of an exaggeration.”
Ren said, looking exasperated. It’s not an exaggeration.
“We should buy some time until the queen arrives—”
Before Itsuki could even finish suggesting that, Trash spoke.
“If you kill the Shield with your own hands, I might still forgive you.”
“Shut up! I’d rather die here than be used by the likes of you!”
“I agree with Ren-san. I have no desire to fight for those who discriminate while the world is heading toward destruction.”
It seems we have no choice but to go to the queen now. To think they’d go so far as to call the queen a fake and interfere… how absurd.
“Very well then. Let’s go. You fools will learn firsthand the folly of opposing the heroes!”
“Ren, Itsuki, Motoyasu… thank you…”
In that moment when Father and I exchanged glances—
“Gotcha! Dieeeeeeeeeee!”
Smoked Meat charged at us. It’s such a hassle being told not to kill him for the sake of negotiations.
“Aiming Lancer! Brionac!”
I raised my spear high—though I had to adjust since we were indoors—and incapacitated Smoked Meat first. I’ll make him atone for the false accusations against Father.
“Guaaaaaaaaaaaah!?”
“Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!?”
“W-Why…? I thought… they were low-level…”
“S-So this is… the strength of otherworlders…”
“It hurts… Ugh… Help me…”
The soldiers all muttered their dying words. Don’t make such a fuss when I’m only attacking to incapacitate.
This is annoying. Should I just finish them all off one by one?
“Die! Fake hero! Haaaaaaaaaah!”

Oh? The Smoked Meat got back up and charged at me again. Surprisingly tough. Last time, it was a skilled knight, but this time it’s just Smoked Meat. I was too focused on the knight before and didn’t pay enough attention to him.
“Too slow.”
Last time, I impaled him through the chest to finish him off, but I need to hold back this time. Let’s aim for the stomach instead. I’ll pierce a spot that won’t kill him.
“Guh!?”
The Smoked Meat stared in disbelief at his own impaled abdomen. And then—
“Gyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!”
A piercing scream echoed. How noisy. It’s making me want to finish him off. The previous knight died in stunned silence, but this guy… he’s ridiculously tenacious.
“I-It huuuuuuuurts! I’m gonna die, I’m gonna die, I’m gonna diiiiiiie! H-Help meeeeeeeee!”
You’ve just been stabbed. The pain should be numbed by now. This is just your brain tricking you. Well, Smoked Meat always struck me as the type to be ruled by his eyes, so this is to be expected.
This is what you were planning to do to us, isn’t it?
No… You were trying to kill us. What I’m doing is far kinder.
“Eek!?”
Ren, Itsuki, and Father raised their voices at the sight of the screaming Smoked Meat. I guess they were startled by how loud he was.
“H-He was trying to kill us… so, i-it can’t be helped, right?”
“Y-Yeah. You have to fend off the sparks before they burn you… This is what battle is. And when your opponent is human, of course there’s… going to be blood…”
“Ah… ahh…”
“He’s not dead yet, you know? I was told not to kill him.”
In fact, everyone around is just incapacitated. Though Smoked Meat is being a bit too noisy.
“Be quiet already. Enough of this.”

I swung my spear, shaking off Smoked Meat, and pierced him with Paralyze Lance before he could fly away. The Smoked Meat, thrown against the wall, was paralyzed and didn’t move a muscle. This should quiet things down a bit.
“Now then…”

As always, the crimson swine and Trash are good at avoiding attacks. They seem to be using the knights as shields, so they’re unharmed. Just as the crimson swine skillfully tried to escape and leave the throne room, the door swung open, and the queen appeared, accompanied by Shadow.
“Where do you think you’re running off to, Malty?”
“Buh!?”
The crimson swine let out a shocked noise. Trash was the same… no, he still had a hint of composure.
“That’s an imposter! Shadow, capture that traitor impersonating the queen! And kill the fake heroes!”
He seemed to be smiling with the confidence of unexpected reinforcements, but mere shadows cannot stop me now.
“Who are you calling a fake?”
The queen’s anger seemed to lower the temperature in the room.
“Well then, Aultcray, whether I’m real or not… why don’t you experience it firsthand?”
‘Root of power, as commanded by the queen—’
“W-What!? That chant… no way—”
Trash stared at the queen in disbelief. The others were also groaning, their eyes widening in shock. ‘Decode the truth once more and bind them with ice.’
“Drei Fa Icecle Prison!”
With the queen’s spell, Trash and the crimson swine were captured. They were frozen up to their heads, left only able to speak.
“Honestly… how much more foolish can you become? Everyone! I declare this now—stop fighting immediately!”
The queen clapped her hands, and all the soldiers who had rushed in, along with the groaning fools, lost their will to fight.
“Bububuh!? Bububu!”
“Impossible! Why is Mirellia here!? She was supposed to be away on a diplomatic mission!”
“With the power of Kitamura-sama, the Spear Hero, she was able to instantly travel across great distances.”
“W-What!?”
Trash glared at me. I gave him a mocking middle finger in response. Then, the queen stood before Trash and slapped his cheek with a loud *paaan*.
“Guh!”

“Not only did you summon the Four Cardinal Heroes without permission, but you also schemed to falsely accuse the Shield Hero! I am beyond words! Are you truly thinking about the good of the kingdom? It’s time you broadened your horizons!”
Then, she punched the crimson swine, who was squealing excuses.
“Malty, everyone here understands that you’re the one in the wrong. Give up already.”
“Buhii! Buhibuhibuhii!”
“I didn’t do anything!”
“Of course, Naofumi-san didn’t do anything.”
“Yeah, there’s no doubt.”
The crimson swine ignored Father and the others, continuing to squeal and cry fake tears at the queen.
What is she even saying? Father doesn’t have the energy to explain right now. Ah, I forgot to mention that I can’t understand pig language.
“Does that change anything?”
“Buh!? Buhbubububuhibuufufufuhii! Bubububu!”
“You weren’t a virgin to begin with, were you? Did you think I wouldn’t know? I see no difference between you and a common whore.”
“A daughter viewed that way by her own parent… how pitiful.”
“Malty would never do such a thing! Mirellia! You need to change your—mmph!”
Trash was smacked by the queen’s fan.
“Aultcray. It’s time you gave up your delusions about Malty. She’s beyond saving.”
“Buhii!”
“Stop pretending to care about Aultcray’s feelings. It’s nauseating.”
Then, she slapped the crimson swine again.
“Bububububu!”

“Did you think I wouldn’t know? How arrogant. If you had truly been involved with Iwatani-sama, the Shield Hero, there might have been a sliver of hope for you… If only you had stayed loyal to him, I might have given you some credit.”
“She’s really going for it now.”
“Please, stop!”
Father shouted. There’s no chance of repairing this relationship anymore.
“Bububu!”
“Did Iwatani-sama truly… while drunk?”
The crimson swine nodded repeatedly.
Impossible. The queen let out a deep sigh.
“Melty.”
“Yes.”
“Testify to everything you’ve seen.”
“Yes, Mother… after Mother left with the heroes, the Shield Hero remained asleep the entire time. There’s no mistake.”
“Bububububuhii!? Bububu!”
The crimson swine was making a fuss, as if insulting her fiancé. She was probably claiming that Melty was lying to slander her.

“Melty would never do such a thing, unlike you. I saw it myself. I watched as you snuck into Iwatani-sama’s room while he was asleep, stole anything of value—money, clothes, and even chainmail—and as you left, you laughed and said, ‘Fufufu… what a foolish man, so easily deceived… I can’t wait for tomorrow.’”
“Bubububuhii!?”
The crimson swine interrupted with a shocked cry.
“Why, you ask? Because I was watching your crime unfold from the attic. I’ve been looking forward to this day—when I could finally scold you like this.”
